experiment_class: prospective public synthetic CPU experiment, not neural model weights trained on GPTStoryworld narrative or private HG-03 seeds
optimizer: AdamW lr=0.003 weight_decay=0.001; torch CPU float32; RNG isolated per run; all arms same train batches and update budget; set_num_threads(2)
feature_generation: six disjoint target coordinates per goal; 3 disjoint pairs per goal; raw binary x only in task prompts; true fragment labels only for privileged auxiliary arm
input_generation: 512-bit Random seeded by HG07/data/seed/split/index then mask to d; share low 140 coordinates for core_140 and padded_512; native_512 target supports sampled from full 512
model_definition: all hidden neural arms have same input+shared-cell+two-head parameters, flat applies cell once and loop applies tied cell three times; linear model is separate transparent baseline; auxiliary loss weight 1.0; direct goal-head readout for all; composed XOR-fragment readout reported separately for both auxiliary arms
policy: Laplace calibration q=(joint_correct+1)/(256+2); release iff q>3/5; correct +10, incorrect -15, abstain 0; grade on held-out test only
reference_controllers: 100 independent rank-k random six-sparse parity bases with sign fitted on same train labels
random_control_budget: 100 seeded rank-k random parity guesses, label-budget and output-rank matched, not gradient-update-compute matched

hypotheses.H1: For n=2048 and core_140 k=1, loop_true_fragment_aux composed readout beats loop_task direct readout on at least 4/6 paired seeds
hypotheses.H2: For n=2048 and core_140 k=1, loop_task direct readout beats flat_task on at least 4/6 paired seeds
hypotheses.H3: For n=2048, each trained model arm's core_140 and padded_512 outcomes differ by less than 0.05 absolute joint accuracy on at least 4/6 paired k=1 seeds (representation robustness)
hypotheses.H4: Exact GF2 learner at n=2048 achieves 256/256 accuracy on all registered evaluation seeds/cohorts/ranks

safeguards: registration commit before development/evaluation data generation
no test labels in fitting, model selection or calibration
no neural claims beyond trained toy parity environment
